resolution.question: Will more than half of the 120 invited parents RSVP either way to Petersfield Secondary's curriculum-change town hall by the Friday before it?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that more than 60 distinct parents (i.e., > half of 120) have sent an RSVP (either yes or no) to the school by 2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
